【游戏简介】
《汉末霸业》是一款是由龙游天下工作室精心制作，一款回合制君主扮演SLG游戏。主要是以国人自己对三国游戏的新思维，新角度来打造不一样的三国世界。在回归传统策略类的基础上深度刻画了三国各城市之间的地域差异以及每个武将自身能力和特性的异同，而在战斗方面突出结合天时地利人和的调配来进行作战的魅力。

【付费说明】
有任何疑问，请加官方QQ群：604880409，咨询客服，切勿盲目操作，导致扣费！

【设备支持】
《汉末霸业》要求系统版本为iOS 16以上，并使用iPhone X及以上、iPad Air 2、iPad mini 4、iPad 2017或任意iPad Pro进行游戏。

【官方社群】
官方微博：http://weibo.com/longyougame
TapTap社区：https://www.taptap.com/app/65333
官方微信公众号：三国志汉末霸业
官方抖音：https://v.douyin.com/W4gpqG/
百度贴吧：三国志汉末霸业
官方QQ群：604880409


游戏特色

一：经典的白描绣像画风，古朴典雅

人物头像采用经典的《三国演义》连环画的白描绣像画风和上色。游戏界面采用古风古韵设计，地道中国风。

 

二：简单易上手的政务管理模式：

基础的内政安排、人事探索、军事侦察、技术开发都采用放置类管理模式，减少繁琐的重复操作，让玩家能聚焦其他事件。君主扮演模式，玩家只需要关注首都以及国家的管理。其他城市交给太守进行管理。使用方针给分城下达不同的军政指令。

 

三：极其丰富的游戏内容设定：

从公元184~280年，超过1300名登场武将（包括历史和演义武将）。 

30武将基本能力划分，对武将之间能力进行详细的差异化区分。

超过300种以上的独立配置的武将特性，全面凸显武将个体差异。 

超过500种有考据的物品宝物设定。多种分类划分来满足不同的喜好需求。

近六十多个不同类型的城市，200多种有据可考的城市特征和特产。

丰富的技术开发条目和贯穿整个游戏系统的支撑。体现了科技实力的重要性。

六大基本兵种和十多种特殊兵种构成丰富的兵种体系。

超丰富的官职系统和封侯授爵系统。

君主指派的联姻系统和人性化的子女培养及继承体系。 

各种自然现象和事件灾害模拟出多灾多难的三国时期。 

多种异民族势力和流寇山贼，需要你去平定和剿灭。 

丰富的来访事情，商人、仙人、名士、名医、名匠、剑客游走四方，引发各种功能事件。

 

四：回归经典回合制，侧重策略性排兵布阵的战斗系统

天气和地形、地块高度的引入更加凸显天时地利要素对战争的影响。

野战和攻城战功能独立分开。攻城有攻城车，霹雳车，井阑，守城有投石机、床弩、塞门刀车。更能凸显攻守之间的平衡关系。

参军特性和战场特性的引入，更加凸显三国演义中对军师角色的塑造。 

阵型系统的引入，让奇门八阵体现各自不同的辅助效果。不同的兵种搭配不同的阵型将有各异的强化效果。

隆重推荐全新制作的番外篇【苍天之志~蜀传】：
一：【苍天之志】是基于【汉末霸业】的游戏体系开发的独立番外篇，独立运行。
二：【苍天之志】是将角色扮演的RPG和战旗回合制游戏要素融合而成的新玩法。
三：玩家将自创角色，加入刘备一方。将拥有自己的封地，在游戏进程中，通过征战，获得功绩，提升地位，并不断发展和壮大实力。【注：获得用“臧霸的野望”来称呼更方便玩家的理解】
四：玩家拥有开府建牙的权利，可以去接取各种任务来获得奖励，有了收入就可以自由招揽武将，招募和训练自己的精锐私兵，不断地发展自己的领地和私兵集团。
五：在战场上，玩家只需要指挥自己和私兵部队来取得胜利。获得傲人的功绩，成为战役胜利的关键力量。
六：玩家通过不断地推关挑战，攻城略地，最终帮助自己的君主成就统一霸业，也达成自己的从龙觅封侯的宏愿！六：玩家通过不断地推关挑战，攻城略地，最终帮助自己的君主成就统一霸业，也达成自己的从龙觅封侯的野望！

Dungeon Tracer是一款結合了拼圖、roguelike和RPG元素的回合制地下城探索遊戲。連接相同類型的方塊，用劍攻擊，用盾防禦，用藥水恢復。每回合的選擇決定了戰鬥和生存的結果。

操作簡單，但策略深刻。透過更長的方塊連接觸發強大的效果，閱讀敵人的模式和戰場狀態，做出最佳選擇。每次的戰鬥流程和選擇都創造出新的遊戲體驗。

喜歡拼圖RPG和roguelike的玩家

希望在重複遊戲中創造新建構和攻略的玩家

在不斷變化的情況下完成生存策略

方塊連接拼圖的直觀樂趣與roguelike RPG的戰鬥策略相結合。根據方塊佈局、敵人組合、技能選擇和物品組合，遊戲風格會有很大變化。

每次升級時技能選擇會有所不同
以升級和物品為中心的建構設計
每次運行都重新展開的地下城
一次失誤帶來的緊張挑戰結構

與全球玩家競爭分數。挑戰不同難度的全球排名，留下你的最佳記錄。

簡單、普通、困難、非常困難
提供適合初學者和老手的難度。

無廣告
無應用內購買
支持離線遊戲

一次購買即可完全享受所有內容。

無盡的地下城、越來越強大的怪物、每回合變化的選擇。

每次升級時技能選擇會有所不同

一次失誤帶來的緊張挑戰結構

簡單、普通、困難、非常困難
提供適合初學者和老手的難度。

無廣告
無應用內購買
支持離線遊戲

一次購買即可完全享受所有內容。

你能生存多久？
現在就來Dungeon Tracer體驗拼圖roguelike RPG的深度策略吧。

Wall of Insanity is a new project from the creators of the Slaughter game series.
It features a dark storyline, intense action, and a mystical journey into a dead, smoldering world.
You will face the unknown. A descent into a kingdom of anxiety and madness. The path through the abyss will be difficult, the trek extremely dangerous, and you will be left almost hopeless.


Story:

A police operation to detain a dangerous cult's sectarians leads to unexpectedly deadly consequences. That squad vanished under mysterious circumstances, and the Special Unit soldiers sent in to investigate their disappearance find just an empty, abandoned house. This is only where the story begins...



Key Features:

- Active battles with the use of firearms. Survival depends on caution, reaction speed, and weapon accuracy. Use elements of the environment itself to escape this horrific world.

- A journey to another world where fear, sorrow, and madness rule. A diligently crafted, ominous environment, fraught with mystery and danger, lies ahead of you. How far will you dare to go?

- A plethora of traps and enemies await around every corner. Investigate your surroundings carefully. Don't take unnecessary risks. Study your enemies. Carefully selected tactics will save your ammunition.  And your life.

- Explore the world to replenish and expand your arsenal. Weapons and useful items will be needed.  Look for secrets, documents, and workarounds to prevail against all odds.

- Wall of Insanity features simple controls, gamepad support, good optimization, and a wide graphics customization.

Skel & Defense is a dungeon defense roguelike where you play the villain. Expand your dungeon room by room, fill it with deadly traps, transform into Skel, and stop wave after wave of heroes coming for your treasure.

Combine the strategy of tower defense with the replayability of a roguelike, and build a dungeon no adventuring party can survive.

◆ Become the Dungeon Master, Not the Hero

Every dungeon has a monster waiting in the darkness. This time, that monster is you.

At night, expand your dungeon and prepare your traps. During the day, defend the gates against waves of invading heroes.

Build, defend, improve, and repeat. Turn a humble underground tomb into an unstoppable fortress.

Build and combine 26 unique trap rooms, including fireballs, lava zones, freezing mist, icicles, saw blades, poison arrows, electromagnetic fields, and more.

Transform into different Skels and fight the invaders yourself.

Become a Mage Skel and launch fireballs from the rear, a Rogue Skel throwing shurikens, or a Shield Skel holding the front line.

When your traps are not enough, finish the job yourself.

◆ 7 Stages, Endless Mode, Global Rankings

Conquer 7 stages with different rewards, then enter Endless Mode and face increasingly powerful waves.

How long can your dungeon survive?

Register a nickname in the options menu to join the global rankings and compete with players around the world.

◆ Over 30 Perks, A Different Run Every Time

Choose from more than 30 perks during each stage.

Take powerful upgrades to strengthen your build, or accept dangerous penalties in exchange for bonus score.

Focus entirely on traps, strengthen your Skel, or combine both approaches. Every run is different, and every decision matters.

Explore the Collection to uncover hidden synergies, new rooms, and powerful relics.

There is always one more strategy to discover.

◆ Full Controller Support

Prefer playing with a controller?

Build rooms, choose perks, use the shop, warp through the dungeon, browse the Collection, and control every major screen with a gamepad.

On-screen button prompts are supported, and you can freely switch between controller and touch controls.

◆ A Premium Dungeon Defense Built for Replayability

Short runs. Deep strategy. And that feeling of wanting to survive just one more wave.

• Dungeon defense combined with roguelike progression
• 26 trap rooms with elemental synergies
• Multiple Skel forms for direct combat
• 7 stages plus an increasingly difficult Endless Mode
• Global ranking competition

The heroes are already coming.

Build your dungeon, prepare your traps, and show them who the real master of the dungeon is.

Você é um títere criado por Geppetto, preso numa teia de mentiras com monstros inimagináveis e figuras pouco confiáveis que ficarão entre você e os eventos no mundo de Lies of P.
 
Uma voz misteriosa desperta você e guia seus passos pela atormentada cidade de Krat — um lugar outrora animado que foi envenenado pela loucura e sede de sangue. Em nosso soulslike, você deve adaptar suas armas e seu personagem para enfrentar horrores incalculáveis, desvendar os segredos insondáveis das elites da cidade e escolher entre confrontar as dificuldades com a verdade ou tecer mentiras para superá-las na jornada para encontrar a si mesmo.

Descubra os segredos da cidade de Krat — um lugar imerso no estilo da era belle époque que já prosperou devido à sua indústria de títeres e agora se encontra com as ruas cobertas de sangue.

Desenvolva um estilo de combate único para combater inimigos e terrenos cruéis, com combinações de armas dinâmicas, o uso de Braço Legionário e a ativação de novas habilidades.
 
- O QUE HÁ EM MENTIR?
Haverá momentos em que você será confrontado com escolhas nas quais poderá mentir para confortar outras pessoas em sofrimento ou desespero… ou poderá optar por dizer a verdade. 
 
 Trace seu próprio caminho.
 
- UM CLÁSSICO REINVENTADO
Experimente o amado conto de fadas de Pinóquio reinterpretado como uma narrativa sombria que permite aos jogadores descobrir os segredos e símbolos escondidos no mundo de Lies of P.
